description: The file defines an interface named ArnInterface within the AWS SDK for PHP, which specifies methods for handling Amazon Resource Names (ARNs), including parsing, string representation, and retrieving individual ARN components.

classes.name: ArnInterface
classes.description: Defines the methods that any class representing an ARN must implement, including parsing from string, converting to string, and retrieving components like partition, service, region, account ID, resource, and converting to array.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Static method to parse an ARN string into an ARN object.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Converts the ARN object back to its string representation.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix part of the ARN.

methods.name: getPartition
methods.description: Returns the partition component of the ARN.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Returns the service component of the ARN.

methods.name: getRegion
methods.description: Returns the region component of the ARN.

methods.name: getAccountId
methods.description: Returns the account ID component of the ARN.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Returns the resource component of the ARN.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns an array representation of the ARN components.
